dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。お越しくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: はい、こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, likewise. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 今いろいろな事が重なってまして、将来の事や子供の事、不安でいっぱいなんです
dialogue.English: A lot of things are piling up right now, and I'm filled with anxiety about the future and my child.

dialogue.content: 色々なことでお悩みなんですね…お辛いですよね…
dialogue.English: You’re struggling with many things… That must be hard.

dialogue.content: 少しずつお話聞かせてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please tell me about it, little by little.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: お話伺っていきたいので、もしよろしければ、あなたのご年齢と性別、家族構成をお聞かせいただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So I can better understand, would you mind telling me your age, gender, and family situation, if you're comfortable with that?

dialogue.content: 40歳女、夫と姑、大学生の息子が一人です
dialogue.English: I’m a 40-year-old woman. I live with my husband and my mother-in-law, and we have one son in college.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださって、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 色々なことが重なってしまっているとのことですが、最初に、お子さんのことをお聞かせいただいてよろしいでしょうか？いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that many things are piling up. To start, would it be alright if we talked about your son? How does that sound?

dialogue.content: お話しやすいところからでもかまいません。
dialogue.English: You can start wherever feels most comfortable for you.

dialogue.content: はい、子供は難病で、手術が近いんです
dialogue.English: Yes, my child has a serious illness, and his surgery is coming up soon.

dialogue.content: お金が多額でなんとかなるんですが
dialogue.English: The cost is high, but we’ll manage somehow.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私自身も資格の試験が近くて
dialogue.English: And I also have a certification exam coming up soon.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 子供も自分のことも中途半端になってるんです
dialogue.English: I feel like I’m being half-hearted with both my child and myself.

dialogue.content: そんな大変な状況なんですね…
dialogue.English: That sounds like a very difficult situation...

dialogue.content: 何から手をつければいいのか…
dialogue.English: I don't know where to even begin...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I hear you.

dialogue.content: お子さんの手術を控えてのご心配はもとより、ご自身の大切なことも抱えながら過ごされているのですね
dialogue.English: With your child’s surgery approaching, you’re understandably worried, and at the same time, you’re also carrying these important matters of your own.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 実は一人暮らしを考えてます
dialogue.English: Actually, I'm thinking of living on my own.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…何から手をつけていいか分からなくなるのも無理もありませんよね…
dialogue.English: I see... It's no wonder you don't know where to start.

dialogue.content: そのための資格なんです
dialogue.English: That's what the certification is for.

dialogue.content: さらに、生活環境の変化もお考えなんですね。
dialogue.English: So you’re also thinking about changing your living situation.

dialogue.content: はい、夫と姑と一緒にいたくなくて
dialogue.English: Yes, I don’t want to live with my husband and my mother-in-law anymore.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: もう部屋も見つけてます
dialogue.English: I’ve already found a place.

dialogue.content: 契約済みです
dialogue.English: I've already signed the contract.

dialogue.content: 一緒に居たくないと思う程お辛いのですね…行動にも移されたのですね
dialogue.English: It must be so painful that you don't want to live with them anymore... and you've already taken action.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: たくさんの不安を抱えてこられるのは、本当にお辛かったですよね…
dialogue.English: Carrying so many anxieties must have been incredibly difficult for you...

dialogue.content: ところで、
dialogue.English: By the way,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 息子さんの体調のこと、とても心配ですよね。。。
dialogue.English: You must be very worried about your son’s health...

dialogue.content: 手術を控えてられるとのことですが、どのような状態なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned he has surgery coming up. What is his condition like?

dialogue.content: そうです、手術は初めてではないんですが心配です
dialogue.English: That's right. It’s not his first surgery, but I’m still worried.

dialogue.content: 今入院中です
dialogue.English: He’s currently hospitalized.

dialogue.content: いろいろあってお見舞いにも行けてない状態で
dialogue.English: With everything going on, I haven’t even been able to visit him.

dialogue.content: 母親として寄り添ってあげられてないなっておもいますあ
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm not there for him as a mother.

dialogue.content: 思います　です
dialogue.English: I mean—that’s how I feel.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。会って励ましてあげられないのは、お辛いですよね…不安ですよね…
dialogue.English: I see. It must be so hard and worrying not being able to see him and encourage him...

dialogue.content: いろいろ重なって不安ですね
dialogue.English: Yes, with everything piling up, I feel so anxious.

dialogue.content: 本当は見舞ってあげたいですよね…色々重なって大変なんですね。どんなご事情がおありですか？
dialogue.English: You really want to be there for him, don't you... It sounds like a lot is happening at once. What are the circumstances, if you don't mind sharing?

dialogue.content: どんな…ですか…うーん、ちょっと整理がつかなくて、何を話せばいいでしょうか
dialogue.English: What circumstances...? Hmm, my thoughts are a bit jumbled, and I'm not sure what to say.

dialogue.content: お金のことも不安だし
dialogue.English: I’m worried about money, too.

dialogue.content: 独り立ちするのも不安はあります
dialogue.English: And I'm anxious about striking out on my own, too.

dialogue.content: ええ。色々考えてしまうのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You have a lot on your mind.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 本当にたくさんの心配事が同じ時期に重なって、どうしていいか不安が募りますよね
dialogue.English: Having so many worries pile up at the same time must make you feel increasingly anxious and unsure of what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、重なったんですよね
dialogue.English: Exactly—everything hit at once.

dialogue.content: 一人で抱えていたのは、本当にお辛かったですよね‥
dialogue.English: It must have been so difficult to carry all of that by yourself...

dialogue.content: そうですね、夫にも言ってませんし
dialogue.English: It has been. I haven't told my husband,

dialogue.content: 姑にもです
dialogue.English: nor my mother-in-law.

dialogue.content: 相談してみても、分かっていただけない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel that even if you tried to talk with them, they wouldn’t understand?

dialogue.content: わかってくれないと思います
dialogue.English: I don’t think they would understand.

dialogue.content: 夫は寡黙で何を考えているのかわかりません
dialogue.English: My husband is quiet and I never know what he's thinking.

dialogue.content: その上亭主関白で
dialogue.English: On top of that, he's very domineering.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…一人で抱えるには、荷が重すぎますよね反応がわかりにくいのですね・・ええ(聞いていますね
dialogue.English: I see... That’s too heavy a burden to carry alone. And it’s difficult when his reactions are so hard to read. I’m listening.

dialogue.content: 問題があるなら言ってくれとか、何考えてるの？とか、もう聞きたくないんです
dialogue.English: I don't want to hear him say things like, "If there's a problem, just tell me," or "What are you thinking?" anymore.

dialogue.content: あなたが聞いてほしいと思うのに、聴いてもらっていると感じられないのですね…
dialogue.English: You want to be heard, but you don’t feel listened to.

dialogue.content: はい、そうだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's it.

dialogue.content: 悲しいですよね…話したくもなくなってしまうのは、お辛いですよね
dialogue.English: That's sad... It must be painful to feel like you don't even want to talk about it anymore.

dialogue.content: ずっと夫や姑の顔色ばかり見てきたので
dialogue.English: I've spent all this time just trying to read my husband's and mother-in-law's moods.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 悲しいもありますし、自分が情けないのもあります
dialogue.English: I feel sad, and I also feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: もう我慢する人生は嫌なので独り立ちです
dialogue.English: I'm tired of a life of just enduring, so I'm going to be independent.

dialogue.content: そこまで思い詰めてられるのですね…あなたの気持ちが分かってもらえないのは悔しいですよね。
dialogue.English: You've been pushed to that point... It must be frustrating not to have your feelings understood.

dialogue.content: 悔しいです　言ってもどうせわからないのでもういいんですけどね
dialogue.English: It is frustrating. I've given up, though, because they wouldn't understand even if I told them.

dialogue.content: わかってほしいのに、受け止めてもらえなくて、
dialogue.English: You want to be understood, but you're not being heard,

dialogue.content: ご家族の顔を伺ってしまうなんて…
dialogue.English: and you end up just trying to read your family's moods...

dialogue.content: いたたまれませんよね・・・
dialogue.English: That must be an unbearable situation...

dialogue.content: 出て行きたくなるのも無理もありませんよね…
dialogue.English: It's no wonder you want to leave...

dialogue.content: そうですね、一緒にいるだけでストレスです
dialogue.English: Yes, just being with them is stressful.

dialogue.content: しんどかったですよね…
dialogue.English: That must have been so exhausting...

dialogue.content: はい、しんどくてもううんざりです
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m exhausted and fed up.

dialogue.content: こんなにもお辛い気持ちを話してくださって、ありがとうございます。今日は一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such painful feelings with me. Let's think about this together today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I appreciate it.

dialogue.content: 今までお話お伺って、私の思うところをお伝えしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Based on what you've told me so far, I'd like to share some of my thoughts.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ご自身にとって大切な試験を控えている中、はじめてではないにしろ、息子さんのことが本当は頭から離れないほどご心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: While you have an important exam of your own coming up, I can tell you're incredibly worried about your son—so much so that it's probably always on your mind, even if this isn't his first surgery.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 気持ちを分かち合いたい身近なご家族にも分かってもらえず、ひとりで抱えてこられるのは苦しかったですよね…
dialogue.English: And it must have been painful to carry this all by yourself, without being understood by the very family you want to share these feelings with...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一番わかってほしい家族に分かってもらえないのは、本当に苦しかったと思います。
dialogue.English: Not being understood by the family you most want to understand you must have been truly agonizing.

dialogue.content: このような大変な中でも、あなたは本当に精いっぱいやってこられたと思います。
dialogue.English: In the midst of all these difficulties, I think you've been doing the very best you can.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたがこんなにも苦しいのは、
dialogue.English: The reason you're in so much pain,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: ご自身の生き方も大切にしながら、息子さんのお体のことはもちろん、何よりも、ご家族野ことを大切にしたかったからではありませんか？
dialogue.English: is that it's because while valuing your own way of life, you also wanted to cherish your son’s health and, above all else, your family. Isn’t that right?

dialogue.content: あなたは、忍耐強く、愛情の深い方なのだと思います。
dialogue.English: I believe you are a very patient and loving person.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません。もっと幸せになりたかったです
dialogue.English: That might be true. I just wanted to be happier.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…気持ち、わかってほしかったですよね…
dialogue.English: I understand... You just wanted them to understand how you feel...

dialogue.content: あれほどわからないとは思ってませんでした
dialogue.English: I never thought they would be so completely unable to understand.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。ここではもっと、吐き出してもいいんですよ
dialogue.English: Yes, yes. You can let it all out here, you know.

dialogue.content: 何が悪い？どこを直せばいい？とかばかり言いますからね
dialogue.English: He just says things like, "What's wrong? What do you need to fix?"

dialogue.content: そんな…気持ちをわかってほしいですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Oh... you just want them to understand your feelings...

dialogue.content: 姑の手前何も言えないので、ずっと我慢していました
dialogue.English: I couldn't say anything in front of my mother-in-law, so I just endured it all this time.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。言いにくいですよね…どんな気持ちでもいいから、ここでぶちまけてもいいんですよ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm. It’s hard to speak up, isn’t it? Whatever you’re feeling, it’s okay to let it all out here.

dialogue.content: 夫にはもっとしっかりしてほしかった
dialogue.English: I wanted my husband to be more reliable.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 姑は仲良くしなさいの一点張りで
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law just insists that we should all get along.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see.

dialogue.content: 結局何もしないし
dialogue.English: But in the end, she doesn't do anything.

dialogue.content: 呆れて何も言えませんでした
dialogue.English: I was so exasperated I couldn't say a word.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: もう一緒にいたくないですね
dialogue.English: I just don't want to be with them anymore.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 因みに、あなたが今一番吐き出したい感情は、どんな気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what is the one feeling you want to let out the most right now?

dialogue.content: それを吐き出しちゃったら、もっと楽になれそうだと思ったのですが…。
dialogue.English: I thought that if you could let that out, you might feel a bit lighter...

dialogue.content: 死んだような人生はもう嫌なのでやり直したいです
dialogue.English: I'm tired of this life that feels like I'm already dead. I want to start over.

dialogue.content: 死んだような人生・・・それは嫌ですよね。では、
dialogue.English: A life that feels like you're dead... yes, nobody would want that. Well then,

dialogue.content: どうなったら、そうではない人生が送れそうだと思いますか？
dialogue.English: what do you think needs to happen for you to live a life that doesn't feel that way?

dialogue.content: まずは一人暮らしです
dialogue.English: First, living on my own.

dialogue.content: 今、一番の願いなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that your greatest wish right now?

dialogue.content: 自分の力で生きていくのがいいと思っています
dialogue.English: I think it’s best to live on my own strength.

dialogue.content: そこまで、ご自身を見つめておられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You've really thought this through for yourself, haven't you?

dialogue.content: 自分の力で生きていく人生”
dialogue.English: "A life lived by your own strength."

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: まずは、一人暮らしをすることで、どんな自分として生きていくイメージが持てそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: To start, by living alone, what kind of image do you have of yourself and the life you would lead?

dialogue.content: 誰の顔色も伺うこともなく、解放されたようなイメージです
dialogue.English: An image of being free, without having to read anyone's mood.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね…。一旦、人の目を気にするっことなく、おひとりで、気持ちを開放してあげたいと思うのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So, for a while, you want to be alone and free your feelings, without worrying about what others think.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: そして、もしも、ひとりになってみて
dialogue.English: And if you were to be on your own,

dialogue.content: 何が一番に手元にあったら、前向きになれると思いますか？
dialogue.English: what is the one thing that, if you had it, would help you feel more positive?

dialogue.content: 何でしょう…何もなくてもいいかもしれません
dialogue.English: I’m not sure… Maybe I don’t need anything.

dialogue.content: 子供はもちろん大事ですが
dialogue.English: My child is important, of course, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そう思られるのですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. That's how you feel.

dialogue.content: 子供も大学を出たら一人暮らしします
dialogue.English: My son will also live on his own after he graduates from college.

dialogue.content: いつかは独り立ちする日が来ると思られるのですね
dialogue.English: So you're thinking that one day he'll be independent.

dialogue.content: いえ、子供が家を出るのは決まっています
dialogue.English: No, it's already decided that he will leave home.

dialogue.content: しっかり親として、冷静に見守っておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: You're calmly watching over him as a responsible parent.

dialogue.content: 本人がそう言ってますのでね
dialogue.English: That's what he says he wants to do.

dialogue.content: 手元に何もなくても大丈夫なような気がします
dialogue.English: I feel I’ll be okay even without anything special at hand.

dialogue.content: ええ。冷静に受け止められているのですね。あなたが、ご自身や息子さんのこともある程度客観的に見られているようでに思います。
dialogue.English: I see. You're accepting it calmly. It seems you're able to look at your own situation and your son's with a degree of objectivity.

dialogue.content: たしかにそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That may indeed be true.

dialogue.content: お話伺って、これからのあなたは、一旦おひとりになることで穏やかになる事ができて、
dialogue.English: From our conversation, it seems that by being on your own for a while, you'll be able to find some peace,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんな風に、冷静に一つ一つのことをご自身の中で時間をかけて整理していけるところに、立っておられるように見えました。
dialogue.English: and you seem to be at a point where you can calmly take the time to sort through each of these things for yourself.

dialogue.content: ご自身では、どのように思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 穏やかになりたいというのはその通りだと思います
dialogue.English: It's true that I want to find peace.

dialogue.content: 私が思ったことなのですが、
dialogue.English: This is just a thought I had, but...

dialogue.content: いろいろ重なっていますので…
dialogue.English: because so many things are piling up...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: ひとつは、ご自身が一人になって、思いのたけを吐き出せる環境に身を置く。(それは、ここに来てもいいし、一人暮らしでも)
dialogue.English: One thing is to put yourself in an environment where you can be alone and let out all your feelings. (That could mean coming here, or by living alone.)

dialogue.content: そして、混乱しそうなこと、重なってると思うことを紙に書き出してみる。
dialogue.English: And then, try writing down on paper the things that feel confusing or that are piling up.

dialogue.content: そうすることで、客観的なあなたなら、一つ一つを見つめることで気持ちから整理されていくのではないかと思うんですね。
dialogue.English: By doing that, since you are an objective person, I think you might be able to sort through things emotionally by looking at them one by one.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、紙には書き出して見たんですが
dialogue.English: Well, I have tried writing things down on paper, but...

dialogue.content: 整理がつかないんですよね
dialogue.English: I just can't seem to get them sorted out.

dialogue.content: どれから手をつければいいのかわかりません
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to tackle first.

dialogue.content: 気持ちからというのは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by "emotionally"?

dialogue.content: ええ。ご自身の気持ちが一番に、納めたいと感じるところから考えてみたら、と思ったのですが。今から一緒に整理するためのお時間はいただけそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes. I was thinking you could start from the thing your heart most wants to resolve. Would you have some time for us to try and sort through it together right now?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。書き出してみたものの中で、あなたが今、気持ちで一番引っかかっているな、と感じる事柄は、どんなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Among the things you wrote down, what is the one that is weighing most heavily on your heart right now?

dialogue.content: うーん、どれも引っかかってる感じなのですが
dialogue.English: Hmm, they all feel like they're weighing on me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 例えば、経済的なことは？どんなでしょう？
dialogue.English: For example, what about financial matters? How do those feel?

dialogue.content: 夫や姑といると息苦しい、でしょうか
dialogue.English: Maybe that being with my husband and mother-in-law feels suffocating.

dialogue.content: 解放されたい
dialogue.English: I want to be free.

dialogue.content: 経済面はなんとかするしかないので、不安はありますが仕方ないです
dialogue.English: As for finances, I’ll just have to make it work. I’m anxious, but it is what it is.

dialogue.content: まずは、この息苦しい気持ちをここで楽にする方法があるのですが、きっとスッキリすると思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: First, there is a way to ease this suffocating feeling right here. I think it will help you feel refreshed. Would you like to try it?

dialogue.content: はい、どうすればいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, what should I do?

dialogue.content: はい、前に進むためにも、やってみましょう
dialogue.English: Alright—let’s try it as a step toward moving forward.

dialogue.content: 解放されたい、息苦しい”吐き出したい一番の感情を一つ、決めてみてくださいね。苦しい、とか、今一番感じる言葉です
dialogue.English: "I want to be free," "It's suffocating." Please choose one main feeling you want to let out. It could be "painful," or whatever word you feel most strongly right now.

dialogue.content: 解放されたい　です
dialogue.English: "I want to be free."

dialogue.content: 解放されたい”　　ですね。手元に紙とクレヨンがあった用意してみて、
dialogue.English: "I want to be free." Okay. If you have some paper and crayons handy, please get them ready.

dialogue.content: 開放されたいイメージって、どんな色かをイメージしてみて、
dialogue.English: Imagine what color the feeling of 'I want to be free' would be for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 思うがままに紙の上に表現してみましょう
dialogue.English: And express it on the paper however you like.

dialogue.content: それは、どんな色でもかまいませんよ
dialogue.English: It can be any color at all.

dialogue.content: できました
dialogue.English: I’ve done it.

dialogue.content: 書き方は、
dialogue.English: As for how you draw,

dialogue.content: 感情に任せて、殴り書きでもいいんですよ
dialogue.English: you can even just let your feelings guide you and scribble.

dialogue.content: はい、書けました
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ve drawn it.

dialogue.content: 自分次第でいいんです！どんな感じがしましたか？
dialogue.English: It's completely up to you! How did that feel?

dialogue.content: 山の上で自由だーという絵を描きました
dialogue.English: I drew a picture of myself on a mountaintop, shouting, "I’m free!"

dialogue.content: 清々しい気分です
dialogue.English: I feel refreshed.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっかすがすがしいんだね。気持ちよさそう！
dialogue.English: I see, I see, so you feel refreshed. That sounds wonderful!

dialogue.content: あなたが握ったクレヨンは、どんな色でもいいし、どんは風に書いてもいい。
dialogue.English: The crayon you held could be any color, and you could draw in any way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたご自身のものだから。あなたの人生も、あなたが握っている。
dialogue.English: Because it's yours. Your life is also in your hands.

dialogue.content: そしてもう、あなたは山の上に来ているのですね！
dialogue.English: And you're already on that mountaintop, aren't you!

dialogue.content: ふむふむ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ふわふわ…優しそうですね…　これから見る景色は、あなたがあなたらしく広げていってほしいと思います。
dialogue.English: It sounds like a gentle, wonderful feeling... I hope that the view you see from now on is one that you can expand in a way that is true to yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll try to do that.

dialogue.content: 客観的で、辛抱強いあなたなら、ご自身のことや、周りの事も見渡して、
dialogue.English: As an objective and patient person, I believe you can survey your own situation and what's around you,

dialogue.content: きっと切り開いていけると思います。今日はいらしてみて、いかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: and I'm sure you can carve out a path for yourself. How do you feel after coming in today?

dialogue.content: いろいろ聞いてもらってちょっと楽になりました
dialogue.English: Having you listen to all of this has made me feel a little lighter.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。もしまた、しんどいことがあったりした時は来てみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I’m glad. If things get tough again, please feel free to come back.

dialogue.content: いつでも応援しております。
dialogue.English: I'll always be here to support you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: では、今日は、ご相談終了させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Then, shall we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: お越しくださって、ありがとうございました。それでは、終了とさせて居td￥あだ来ますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. We'll conclude our session now.

dialogue.content: いただきますね。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you again. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: はい、失礼致します
dialogue.English: Yes, goodbye.

dialogue.content: （遅くまですみませんでした。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Sorry for keeping you so late. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: ロープレ終了といたしますね。勉強になりました！
dialogue.English: We'll end the role-play here. This was a great learning experience!

dialogue.content: （とんでもありません。長時間おつかれさまでした！）
dialogue.English: (Not at all. Thank you for your hard work during this long session!)

dialogue.content: お疲れさまです
dialogue.English: Thank you for your hard work.
